features.name: ticket_to_revenue_est
features.description: Invoice size relative to exporter annual revenue.
features.why_cross_sector: A large invoice is only risky relative to the exporter's scale.

features.name: outstanding_to_revenue_est
features.description: Existing Rawasi exposure relative to exporter annual revenue.
features.why_cross_sector: Measures concentration and overextension independent of industry labels.

features.name: advance_tenor_exposure
features.description: Advance percentage multiplied by payment tenor in days.
features.why_cross_sector: Combines how much Rawasi advances with how long capital is at risk.
